title: Trump Expected to Sign Executive Order on AI Oversight Amid Security Concerns
detail: President Trump is expected to sign an executive order addressing AI oversight as security concerns mount among supporters and allies. The order reflects growing pressure to establish guardrails on artificial intelligence development and deployment, with both national security officials and political allies raising alarms about risks posed by advanced AI systems. The move signals a notable shift in the administration's approach to AI governance.

media.caption: Trump expected to sign executive order on AI oversight as security fears mount
